jobs.description_text: Principal, User Experience Newton Research [Research & Development] [Boston, New York City, or Remote] Company Description Newton Research is a fast-growing software start-up founded by repeat entrepreneurs and well-funded by blue chip venture capital firms. About the Role Brands and agencies spend billions a year on media and still struggle to answer two questions: what is actually working, and what should we do next? Their tools don't help much. Mediaocean is the system of record for what they bought. The DSP is the system of action for how it ran. Nothing owns the why — the decision itself. That is what Newton is building: the system of decision for media investment, and increasingly the system that acts on those decisions. A causal engine explains what drove the outcome, agents turn that into a plan, and governed action carries it back into the platforms where the money is spent. Today that means decision intelligence for humans. Next it means decisions that execute with approval, and eventually within policy the customer sets. Design is what makes that real. Our users are media planners, buyers, analysts, and CMOs, not data scientists, and they have to trust a recommendation enough to move real budget behind it — and then hand over more of the doing. The conventions for that don't exist yet. Nobody has settled how a media team teaches an agent the way they work, directs a dozen of them at once, or corrects one in a way that makes the whole system smarter next cycle. Whoe

jobs.description_text: QA Engineer, AI-Native Quality Newton Research Research & Development Boston / Needham, MA Company Description Newton Research is a fast-growing software start-up founded by repeat entrepreneurs and well-funded by blue chip venture capital firms. About the Role Newton ships on a sprint cadence through a develop, stage and customer-environment pipeline, and the product surface is wide: conversations, blueprints, connectors, scheduled tasks, permissions and sharing, SSO, and AI agents whose behavior is not fully deterministic. A missed regression lands in front of a media planner or a customer's security review. We run everything through an AI-first lens, because it is the only way quality scales. If a quality task is repeatable, an agent does it and you supervise; if it takes judgment, that is where you spend your time. The gap this hire fills: evals and skill-change testing. Code changes already have CI and review, including PRs written by Claude. What has no safety net is behavior change: an edit to a skill, a prompt, a tool definition or a model version can silently change what our agents do, and nothing tests that today. You own that layer: curated eval sets, scoring and regression tracking, so any change to how an agent behaves is measured before it ships. Measure the AI: agent output varies run to run, so “correct” is a range you define with evals, rubrics and scoring, not an exact-match assertion. jobs.description_text: The Role: We're looking for a software engineer to join the Neo4j Sharding Engineering team. We own Infinigraph and Composite , and we make them work as managed offerings on Aura, Neo4j’s cloud platform. Aura is Neo4j’s fully managed graph database as a service. Customers create, scale, and use Neo4j databases in the cloud without installing, clustering, or operating the database themselves. Aura runs on Kubernetes across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure, and handles provisioning, networking, security, upgrades, and day-to-day operations for those databases. Composite is the technology behind distributed query execution in Neo4j: one query can span multiple databases. Infinigraph is our database sharding offering for large data volumes, built on a distributed database architecture. Distributed query execution is a complex and interesting topic covering query language design, performant networking, and concurrency. Those capabilities still have to run as a cloud product, and that's where a large part of this role sits: building the Go services and Kubernetes machinery that provision, scale, and operate sharded and composite clusters on Aura, reliably, at the data volumes our customers keep growing into. As part of an energetic and fun team of engineers, you'll work at the frontier of designing and implementing new capabilities for Neo4j on Aura.
